items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Well, he's the last guy we played together, not so long, about, uh, three weeks ago.

ctx.x: Oh, Ernest Milton, I don't think I know him. I don't know him, how did you play?
No, no, he's a drummer. Drummer. Hey, he's a drummer. Well, he's the last guy we played together, not so long, about, uh, three weeks ago. Uh-huh.
I've heard Moran was Lizzie Miles, is it a half-brother or full-brother, do you remember?
